Modern material reference, not a scan or calibrated sample of Pennsylvania Station; grain scale and colour remain interpreted

Modern beige-marble appearance interpretation. Gibbs specifies marble public floors without certifying their variety, and Botticino ticket-booth exteriors. This asset is not a station sample or a verified Botticino/Tennessee scan.

runtime: Shared content-addressed KTX2/UASTC; 2K desktop/512px mobile. Appearance revision4 changes only interpreted colour and normal strength, keeping architectural UV revision3 and the existing roughness, metallic and AO data.
lighting: Blender Cycles neutral dome, six diffuse bounces and separate 2m AO; registered complete station, railway, context and rolling-stock occluders are included. Directional sun remains dynamic. Lighting-only outgoing radiance uses explicit Linear Rec.709 to Standard/sRGB PNG encoding, per-atlas HDR normalization and pixel-identical lossless WebP transport; browser restores scale and multiplies by pi for Three.js irradiance. Fine ironwork is excluded from the masonry atlas. Original HDR/AO authoring files and measured unit-hemisphere/browser calibration are retained outside runtime. Exact sample counts/resolutions and source hashes are recorded per delivered bake.
reflections: Three static room-centre HDR panoramas plus one elevated Seventh Avenue environment are captured from the assembled authored station under a neutral dome and afternoon reference sun. The old modern field HDR is archived. No parallax correction, moving-passenger reflections or time-specific indirect relighting; neither original material colours nor sun/exposure settings are historically calibrated. Source hashes/positions are in the runtime capture reports.
denoising: Color-only OpenImageDenoise on explicitly recovered linear radiance; runtime sRGB is encoded once and pixel-verified lossless WebP is used. All four source/report hashes, mean changes, uniform transfer controls and clipping counts are retained in lighting-*-denoise.json. Filtering may soften tiny atlas features; mapped production views are separately reviewed.

appearance.scope: Interpreted base-colour derivatives and reduced normal-strength scalars on existing material families. Geometry, physical grain scale, normal-map pixels, roughness/metallic/AO maps and lightmap/probe files are retained.
appearance.method: Decode sRGB to linear; normalize each source channel by its spatial mean; apply contrast about that mean and multiply by the target linear palette; clip to0..1; resize in linear light; encode sRGB once.
appearance.baseColourFactors: Existing glTF baseColorFactor values are retained; the application report records each factor times the decoded UASTC map mean.
appearance.lightingLimitation: This narrow appearance change retains the Phase3 indirect-illumination solution and static probes. It does not rebake the effects of revised albedo on secondary bounce light or restore the lost split-atlas/reflection work.
